recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中顆粒呈大脂肪空泡與稀疏基質條索構成的網狀結構，背景主要是紅血球，有核造血細胞非常稀少；脂肪空泡多、造血細胞少，代表明顯低細胞性骨髓。
features: Aspirate spicules composed of large empty fat spaces outlined by thin stromal strands
Very sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells scattered among red cells
Background dominated by red cells, without cellular trails
No clusters of blasts or abnormal cells seen
Cellular detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows spicules composed largely of empty fat spaces outlined by thin stromal strands, with very sparse nucleated hematopoietic cells in a background dominated by red cells. No abnormal cellular clusters are identified, although individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The findings indicate a markedly hypocellular marrow with reduced trilineage hematopoiesis. In the clinical context of pancytopenia, findings are consistent with inherited bone marrow failure due to dyskeratosis congenita.

ddx.vs: Aspirate appearance is the same; telomere length testing by flow-FISH and germline genetics identify dyskeratosis congenita.
Also hypocellular; chromosomal breakage testing with DEB or mitomycin C distinguishes Fanconi anemia.

ddx.dx: Hemodilute aspirate from a normocellular marrow
ddx.vs: Hemodilution reduces nucleated cells but spicules retain hematopoietic cells, and the core biopsy shows normal cellularity.
